name: The gateway to the convent of Santa Clara, Macau
dimensions: Dimensions taken from <u>Victoria & Albert Museum Department of Prints and Drawings and Department of Paintings, Accessions 1928. </u> London: HMSO, 1929
summary: A drawing of the baroque gateway leading from the 'Franciscan Green' to the convent of Santa Clara, Macau; the inscription refers to a similar gate to the church of S. José.
